constraints: One title at a time. The live game gets every cycle until it is healthy.
No dark patterns. Every monetization decision is honest by default.
Store-facing changes (pricing, metadata, screenshots) wait for operator approval for the first 30 days.
brief.description: A solo-founder studio shipping one premium mobile puzzle game a year, sold once at a fair price.
brief.free_text:
**The release-readiness rule.** A build goes to the store only when all three hold; any one failing sends it back to the previous milestone.
(1) *Crash-free session rate* — measured on the current device set, never a historical average.
(2) *Store metadata parity* — every locale states the same claims as the primary listing.
(3) *Rollback readiness* — the previous build is still deployable without a data migration.

goals: Maintain a 4.6+ App Store rating across the live title
A content update lands every 6 weeks on cadence, never slipping two cycles in a row
Refund rate stays below 3% quarter over quarter
brief.name: Indie Game Studio

$30,000 monthly net revenue from premium sales, sustained for two consecutive quarters within 12 months of launch.

brief.we_are:
We are a single-title premium mobile studio. One game, polished relentlessly,
sold once at a fair price. We grow through word of mouth and store features, not
ad spend. Rating, refund rate, and update cadence are the only numbers that
matter on a given day.

---
we_are_not: **We are NOT** a free-to-play studio. We do not ship loot boxes, we do not run energy timers, and we do not gate content behind currency. Monetization is a single honest purchase, because the brand is "premium, no tricks."

**We are NOT** a multi-title shop. We do not split focus across a portfolio, and we do not start a second title while the live one needs work. The live title gets all attention, because focus is the only edge a solo studio has.
